## Overview Enable serialized ModelOpt per-tensor and per-channel FP8 linear weights to be reused by the weight-cache daemon with CUTLASS. Related to #56049; depends on #63672 for restoring CUTLASS's logical output width. Incremental review: https://github.com/liusy58/vllm/compare/35711168b0135573234bbaa4bd8f9e8fe32647e8...7f75449765425d759565d3a770d829070d909f99 (the GitHub diff against main includes the prerequisite). ## Claims - Enable CUDA IPC for ModelOpt `FP8` and `FP8_PER_CHANNEL_PER_TOKEN` linear layers using CUTLASS and the default format scheme. - Restore the transposed-weight layout metadata without transposing, requantizing, padding, or mutating the daemon's already processed weights/scales a second time. - Keep other ModelOpt FP8 backends and block FP8 unsupported; existing FP4/MXFP8 capability rules are unchanged. ## Validation Current head `7f75449765425d759565d3a770d829070d909f99` includes main `914d61fc538a84e8487cb16fe8241a70f6f4bf9e`. October 29 agent-run validation after resolving the inherited online-FP8 import conflict with upstream #60163. The merge retains both CUTLASS and Humming imports, the upstream processed-dimension metadata, and upstream rejection of the unsupported Humming per-token/channel path. It adds no Humming IPC capability. | Check | Exact-head result | |---|---| | `modelopt-layers` | 117 passed, 5 deselected, 14 warnings in 85.71s (0:01:25) | | `modelopt-model` | 1 passed, 70 deselected, 18 warnings in 78.89s (0:01:18) | | Full feature-file and commit hooks | Passed, including mypy and ruff | Runtime: NVIDIA B300, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130, process-local CUDA 13.4 compatibility libraries. The two stable-libtorch extensions are from the official CUDA 13.0 wheel for main `914d61fc538a84e8487cb16fe8241a70f6f4bf9e`, checked against wheel RECORD hashes and linked only into task worktrees. The shared venv and host driver were unchanged. This does not validate the full upstream PyTorch 2.14 dependency matrix. Full-model checks use TP1, BF16, eager mode, CUTLASS and TRITON_ATTN, with the existing batch-invariant exact greedy-output comparisons. Each completed case checks ordinary load, missing-daemon fallback, IPC and a second IPC load; both IPC loads forbid fallback. These are output-equivalence smoke checks, not accuracy or performance benchmarks. No multi-GPU, ROCm or other-backend result is claimed. ModelOpt full-model tests use their checked-in configurations without checkpoint/budget overrides. Per-channel/per-token checkpoint: `CedricHwang/qwen2.5-0.5b-modelopt-fp8-pc-pt`, pinned `d9c87375a9b950b1c7965a1110ac6ca455929726`.
Commands for this revision All commands set `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`, `PYTHONPATH` to the corresponding worktree and `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/liusy/codex-runtime/cuda-compat-13-4/usr/local/cuda-13.4/compat`. ```bash CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=5 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/quantization/test_modelopt.py -k 'not checkpoint_setup and not nested_mixed_checkpoint and not mixed_dspark_checkpoint' -q CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=5 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_weight_cache.py -k modelopt_fp8 -q ```
GitHub checks for the new head are pending at publication. No Buildkite GPU-suite pass or completed human review is claimed. AI assistance and original feature baselines are recorded below.
Earlier validation and original feature baselines (previous heads) NVIDIA B300, BF16, CUTLASS linear backend. The real-model test uses `CedricHwang/qwen2.5-0.5b-modelopt-fp8-pc-pt`, pinned to `d9c87375a9b950b1c7965a1110ac6ca455929726`, TP1, eager mode, TRITON_ATTN and `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1`. | Check | Before implementation, base `93a266aaa2` plus new tests | With implementation | |---|---|---| | Real checkpoint, ordinary loading → missing-daemon fallback → IPC → second IPC | 1 failed, 48.62s: daemon rejects ModelOptLinearMethod | 1 passed, 74.98s; exact output equality for both prompts × 16 generated tokens across all four loads | | Fused linear layers, tensor/channel scales × aligned/padded output widths, two attachments each | 4 failed, 10.28s: pre-processed weights rejected | All 4 pass; exact outputs, shared pointers and tensor contents preserved | | Unsupported Torch/Triton backend rejection | — | Both pass | | Existing ModelOpt suite excluding five checkpoint-setup/integration cases; includes all six new layer cases | — | 113 passed, 5 deselected, 72.13s | | Changed-file and commit hooks | — | Passed, including mypy and ruff | Both real IPC loads set `fallback=False`. The deterministic generation comparison is a smoke evaluation, not a broad accuracy benchmark. Full-model coverage is per-channel/per-token; static per-tensor FP8 is covered by real CUDA layers with unequal fused-projection scales. No performance, multi-GPU, other-platform, or FP8-MoE claim is made. ```bash CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_weight_cache.py -k modelopt_fp8 -q CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/quantization/test_modelopt.py -k 'preprocessed_shared_weights or preprocessed_unsupported_backend' -q CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/quantization/test_modelopt.py -k 'not checkpoint_setup and not nested_mixed_checkpoint and not mixed_dspark_checkpoint' -q ``` `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` assumes the pinned checkpoint and OPT-125m configuration are cached; omit it for the initial download. Before implementation the first command reported: ```text UnsupportedQuantForIPCError: layer model.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj: ModelOptLinearMethod does not support loading from pre-processed weights. 1 failed, 70 deselected, 16 warnings in 48.62s ``` The four new shared-weight layer cases reported `RuntimeError: layer : ModelOptLinearMethod does not support pre-processed weights`. With the implementation, all six new cases passed in 12.00s; the full selected regression run above was repeated after test formatting/type-check fixes. Runs emitted existing torch deprecation warnings. Initial setup attempts encountered a missing offline revision reference and a changing-free-memory profiling assertion; the pinned, isolated baseline above then reproduced the intended rejection.
## Details The daemon currently rejects every ModelOpt FP8 linear method even when CUTLASS can consume the processed tensor layout. Opt in only the two plain FP8 weight schemes with the actual selected CUTLASS kernel and no format wrapper. The engine restores `processed_weight_dims=(0, 1)` and returns before post-load weight transformations. CUTLASS logical width is initialized from configuration by #63672, so padded shared weights still produce the original output width. The existing L4 preload CI step now selects the real ModelOpt IPC test and the six layer cases, with dependencies on the changed ModelOpt source and tests. The preload feature guide documents the formats, matching daemon/engine kernel configuration, and exclusions. Local validation used B300; L4 CI has not been run locally. No new scheduler/model-runner path or steady-state GPU synchronization. Duplicate checks on October 26 covered #56049 and its comments, issue-linked PRs, and open searches for ModelOpt FP8 preload/pre-processed weights. #63672 covers online quantization and NVFP4, #63673 covers compressed-tensors FP8, and #62036 covers W4A16 NVFP4 layerwise reload; none implements this serialized ModelOpt FP8 IPC path. This branch includes main `373614f66d`. AI assistance: Codex implemented and ran the recorded validation at the submitter's request. This is a draft for human review; no completed human approval or human-run tests are asserted. ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Narrow capability opt-in and metadata restoration; existing loading and kernel interfaces reused. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Real checkpoint before/after, exact real-layer tests, regression results and CI resource limits recorded above. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Changed-file hooks passed; rendered preload docs and CI selection updated. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Root cause, prerequisite, duplicate checks, commands, evidence, limitations and AI disclosure included.

files.patch:
@@ -260,6 +260,12 @@ Socket paths are derived from the GPU UUID, so they are stable regardless of
   The engine reuses the quantized weights and scales without running online
   quantization again. This does not enable online MoE quantization or
   conversion from an already quantized checkpoint.
+  Serialized ModelOpt `FP8` (per-tensor) and `FP8_PER_CHANNEL_PER_TOKEN`
+  linear layers also support CUDA IPC with the CUTLASS linear backend.
+  Set the same `--kernel-config '{"linear_backend": "cutlass"}'` on the daemon
+  and engine. Engines reuse the processed weights and scales, including
+  fused-projection scales and output padding. This does not enable ModelOpt
+  block FP8, FP8 MoE, or other FP8 linear backends.
   ModelOpt NVFP4 MoE supports the TRT-LLM and vLLM CUTLASS backends. With
   CUTLASS, the daemon fuses activation scales once; engines reuse the fused
   scales without modifying the daemon's shared tensors.

@@ -412,6 +412,41 @@ def _run_online_quantization(
     run_cold_start_and_warm_restart(vllm_runner, case, tmp_path)
 
 
+MODELOPT_FP8_CASE = ModelCase(
+    model="CedricHwang/qwen2.5-0.5b-modelopt-fp8-pc-pt",
+    prompts=["The capital of France is", "Hello, my name is"],
+    llm_kwargs=dict(
+        revision="d9c87375a9b950b1c7965a1110ac6ca455929726",
+        dtype="bfloat16",
+        gpu_memory_utilization=0.2,
+        enforce_eager=True,
+        max_model_len=512,
+        attention_config={"backend": "TRITON_ATTN"},
+        kernel_config={"linear_backend": "cutlass"},
+    ),
+    daemon_args=[
+        "--revision",
+        "d9c87375a9b950b1c7965a1110ac6ca455929726",
+        "--dtype",
+        "bfloat16",
+        "--attention-backend",
+        "TRITON_ATTN",
+        "--kernel-config",
+        '{"linear_backend": "cutlass"}',
+    ],
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.has_device_capability(89)),
+    reason="ModelOpt FP8 CUTLASS weight cache requires SM89+",
+)
+def test_ipc_cache_modelopt_fp8(vllm_runner, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    """Serialized ModelOpt FP8 tensors survive repeated IPC attachment."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT", "1")
+    run_cold_start_and_warm_restart(vllm_runner, MODELOPT_FP8_CASE, tmp_path)
+
+
 NVFP4_CASE = ModelCase(
     model="nvidia/Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4",
     prompts=["The capital of France is", "Hello, my name is"],

@@ -18,6 +18,9 @@
     init_mxfp8_linear_kernel,
     init_nvfp4_linear_kernel,
 )
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.scaled_mm import (
+    CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel,
+)
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import Attention, MLAAttention
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import (
     FusedMoEConfig,
@@ -2715,10 +2718,14 @@ def __init__(
 
     @property
     def supports_pre_processed_weights(self) -> bool:  # type: ignore[override]
-        # TODO(Isotr0py): support fp8 ModelOpt kernels transpose/repack.
         w = self.spec.weight
         return isinstance(w, QuantKey) and (
             w.dtype == FP4_DTYPE
+            or (
+                w in (kFp8StaticTensorSym, kFp8StaticTokenSym)
+                and isinstance(self.kernel, CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel)
+                and type(self.fmt) is FormatScheme
+            )
             or (
                 w == kMxfp8Static
                 and self.kernel is not None
@@ -2768,6 +2775,8 @@ def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer) -> None:
                 raise RuntimeError(
                     f"{type(self.kernel).__name__} cannot use pre-processed weights"
                 )
+            if self.spec.weight in (kFp8StaticTensorSym, kFp8StaticTokenSym):
+                layer.processed_weight_dims = (0, 1)
             return
         self.fmt.pre_process(layer)
         self.wkey.process(layer, WEIGHT)
